definitions.gloss: to work for, to be employed at
definitions.explanation: To be employed at a company or organization. Focuses on the place of employment rather than the job itself.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}に{勤|つと}めています。
{大|おお}きい{会社|かいしゃ}に{勤|つと}めたいです。
examples.english: I want to work at a big company.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{病院|びょういん}に{勤|つと}めています。
examples.english: My father works at a hospital.

notes: Different from {働|はたら}く which is more general 'to work'. {勤|つと}める specifically means being employed at an organization. The workplace takes the particle に. Related: {勤務|きんむ} (work/service).
